text:
### 1. 创建SWR镜像拉取Secret
```bash
kubectl create secret docker-registry swr-secret \
  --docker-server=swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com \
  --docker-username=cn-north-4@<AK> \
  --docker-password=<SK>
```

### 2. 按顺序应用配置
```bash
kubectl apply -f 01-configmap.yaml
kubectl apply -f 02-secret.yaml
kubectl apply -f 03-pvc.yaml
kubectl apply -f 04-redis-deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f 05-redis-service.yaml
kubectl apply -f 06-backend-deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f 07-backend-service.yaml
kubectl apply -f 08-nginx-configmap.yaml
kubectl apply -f 09-frontend-deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f 10-frontend-service.yaml
kubectl apply -f 11-backend-hpa.yaml
```

### 3. 验证部署
```bash
kubectl get pods
kubectl get svc
kubectl get hpa
kubectl get pvc
```

## 配置说明
- **组织名**: ren-li
- **后端镜像**: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ren-li/flask-backend:v1
- **前端镜像**: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ren-li/nginx-frontend:v1
- **Redis密码**: pwd (base64: cHdk)
- **存储类**: csi-disk-topology
- **HPA配置**: minReplicas=1, maxReplicas=4, CPU阈值=60%
